claim: Phase map: N=3 HD->HI at ~1.36 um spot; N=4 HI at all tested spots; N=5-9 HI only at NA 0.80; N>=10 stripe domains block uniform reversal.
Control: comparable Gaussian beams permanently damage N=3-5 films and give random multidomain states at N=6-9.
Switching is cumulative: ~200-2,000 pulses per illuminated area at 1 kHz (~200 at 5 um/s with a 1 um spot); total write time, minimum pulse count and maximum usable rate were not measured.

Kaplan-Gehring period with Ms=0.9 MA/m, Keff=0.5 MJ/m3, Aex=15 pJ/m, t=0.6N nm: N=3 ~0.25 m, N=5 ~224 um, N=7 ~12.5 um, N=9 ~2.7 um, N=10 ~1.6 um, N=12 ~0.75 um; the period crosses the optical spot scale at N~9-10.

The stripe-domain law is scoped to continuous exchange-coupled films; granular (exchange-decoupled) media void its premises (Iwasaki 1976; CoCrPt-oxide media; Lambert et al., Science 345, 1337 (2014), 15 nm granular FePtAgC).
Granular escape charges a stochastic price: per-grain coin flip at full demagnetization, MCD bias ~2-5%, 10^2-10^4 pulses per grain; ensemble alignment figures disagree across sources.

IFE amplifier forks by material class: ~0.3 T threshold for Co/Pt class vs ~10 T for FePt (Ellis 2016); plasmonic enhancement suffices only for the low-anisotropy class; cavity route rejected on Q-smearing.
Delta=60 coherent-volume crossings: FePt grain ~2.5 nm (Ku 5 MJ/m3, t 10 nm); Co/Pt 12 nm ~6.4 nm; Co/Pt 5.4 nm ~9.6 nm (Keff 0.5) and ~12.4 nm (Keff 0.3); at 30 nm Delta ~350-1300.
Nucleation caveat: Co nano-squares on Pt measured Ep=0.95+/-0.2 eV (Delta 38+/-8) vs macrospin ~100 eV (Delta ~4000), a ~100x discount (arXiv:1312.7301).

TERMINAL NODE: the energy barrier per optically written bit has no published measurement in any material class; a Sharrock / time-decay protocol decides it, and the outcome branches the roadmap at Delta 40 and 60.
Write latency = pulse count x cooling-limited spacing; ~300 ps re-write floor (GdFeCo) caps rate at ~3 GHz; kHz demos take ~1 s (UCSD) and ~0.5 s (granular FePt) per bit.
Energy per bit: UCSD ~12 pJ, classic AO-HDS ~640 pJ, plasmonic TbFeCo ~4.9 pJ, toggle limit ~120 aJ (40x40x20 nm3 at 6 J/cm3); HAMR ~2 pJ optical per bit.

'Optical switching speed' is a category weld: read off the 120 fs pulse; decomposes into pulse duration, pulse count, repetition ceiling, thermal recovery, write latency; write latency has no reading.
The thickness ceiling was a presented binary (thin+switchable vs thick+retentive) whose option space never included the beam; presented-binary audit: documented 5 / asserted 3 / absent 3, share 0.46.
